decisions.reason: As a psychiatric care offer with its own page, it reflects visible investment and a close fit to the firm's care mission, which makes management likely to continue it unless problems become unmistakable.

Although a carpentry workshop is less central than direct care, a standalone page suggests meaningful commitment and sunk investment, so management would be inclined to persist rather than exit quickly.
Outpatient sociotherapy is strategically related to residential and psychosocial support, and despite lower website prominence, management can plausibly justify giving it more time.
Being featured on the home page signals strong public commitment and the service is highly aligned with senior care, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely.
The retail shop is relatively peripheral and only lightly promoted, but its link to sheltered-workshop activities still gives management reasons to maintain it rather than admit failure quickly.
